name: 嘟嘟煲
evolution: 嘟嘟煲 → 嘟嘟锅 Lv.38
description: 体内的粘液有毒性，总是黏糊糊的，一旦沾上很难洗掉，粘液的沸点十分低，常处于沸腾状态。
descriptionEn: The mucus inside its body is toxic and always sticky; once it gets on something it is very hard to wash off. The mucus has a very low boiling point and is constantly in a boiling state.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 毒泡泡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 取念
skills.description: 每回合随机变成敌方任意精灵的技能，且该技能能耗-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn, randomly becomes a skill of any of the enemy's spirits, and that skill's energy cost -2.

skills.name: 拍击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 毒孢子
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 5 stacks of Poison.

skills.name: 腐蚀酸液
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Poison.

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each stack of Poison on the enemy, the user gains Magic Attack +30%.

skills.name: 瘴气喷射
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 疫病吐息
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 1 stack of Poison Mark.

skills.name: 落井下毒
skills.description: 使敌方精灵减益的层数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the number of stacks of debuffs on the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 毒雾
skills.description: 将敌方所有增益，转化成中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Converts all of the enemy's buffs into Poison.

skills.name: 鸩毒
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本次技能威力+10，应对状态：改为本次威力+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each stack of Poison on the enemy, this skill's power +10; countering status: instead this power +40.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each stack of Poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost -1; the enemy gains 1 stack of Poison.

skills.name: 剧毒
skills.description: 敌方获得3层中毒，应对防御：改为获得8层。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 3 stacks of Poison; countering defense: instead gains 8 stacks.
